notes.title: The Co-Op Update
notes.content:
Using Steam Remote Play you can now explore the archives with your friends anywhere in the world! Only one player will be able to use the mouse and keyboard, meaning other players will need to play with  their controllers - we promise you get used to playing with controller.
You can also play locally with your friends in real life (if you have those)! Either way, to get started press the following button from the main menu:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41505764/e965bfcd17762495c350b3748fd1689f0988143e.png[/img]

Then just press any button on your connected controller or keyboard/mouse and another player will spawn (Art Temporary™)! Currently you can play with up to 3 players, although we recommend sticking with 2.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41505764/f371479df5595ebdb8f84c329af9066d9c52846f.png[/img]

For more details on how to use Steam's Remote Play please visit [url=https://store.steampowered.com/remoteplay]https://store.steampowered.com/remoteplay[/url].

If you are a beta user, you will have access to this feature right away! Demo users will be able to use this when the game releases in early access this year.

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Live Stream #2
notes.content:
[b]Steam Next Fest Live Stream[/b]
Come join us on Thursday, 24th of February at 12pm Pacific to watch us play the developer build of Abandoned Archive, as we talk about the future of the game and answer some questions from chat.

[b]What is Abandoned Archive?[/b]
Abandoned Archive is a uniquely crafted, fast-paced, spellcasting roguelike, inspired by games such as Enter the Gungeon and Wizard of Legend. Set in an archive that has been long forgotten and sealed away, the player must venture deep below ground to uncover the dark secrets tucked away. Cast and customise spells to your liking, while scouring various floors to find powerful relics, each with a history of its own. Fight to protect Oblome - a self-proclaimed scientist and resident of the archive - as he spares no effort in his attempts to protect you. There is definitely something stowed away, some kind of synthetic horror at the base of this archive. Will you delve deep and decipher the mysteries? Or will you simply succumb to your surroundings?
